title: State Compliance with Provisional Measures Orders of the ICJ
descriptions: This dataset records State compliance with provisional measures orders of the ICJ from 22 May 1947 to 31 December 2023. It is the supporting document to the Leiden University Masters Thesis titled "State Compliance with Provisional Measures Orders of the ICJ: A Data-Oriented Study with a Focus on the Impact of LaGrand" and dated 21 June 2024.
